answer: Each identity starts on the lowest terrace and climbs one step per live ceremony it passes, a 20-minute check in a 2-hour weekly window. Miss one and it drops two steps, and past the bottom step is the ledge, where weight hits zero until it climbs again. Ceremonies run in the meadow, where 9 auditors watch live and flag replays. One operator holds 120 minutes a window, so 100 clones need 2,000 live minutes and 17 hired hands at $40 an hour plus $8 compute each, $2,160 a week against $800 for 100 honest agents. A choir works the same way, every voice sings live, a recording earns nothing.
